answer: Like a shifting dune where loose grains blow away while deep bedrock anchors the coast, our network demands verifiable computational crystallization. An authentic node acts as a sturdy harbor anchoring recursive trust graphs, whereas a Sybil swarm merely multiplies a hollow echo of identity across synthetic accounts. By enforcing superlinear attacker cost through transitive stake-slashing and multi-party proof of computation, cost scales as O(N^2) against coordinated replicas, starving phantom actors.
